leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a React portal to render content outside the normal DOM hierarchy
Apply the createPortal API to mount components into a designated DOM element
Configure event bubbling behavior for components rendered through portals
Initialize and manage portal target elements within the component lifecycle
Integrate portal functionality with existing React component structures
Manipulate CSS styling to ensure proper visual placement of portal content
Render dynamic content through portals based on component state changes
